# cb:b059 · prescription-grounding

> A prescription is adopted: every active prescription grounds in deps (the beliefs it rests on) or in a stipulation artifact citing plan:, user:, session:, or document: - the record of the adoption event. External-source schemes never ground a prescription.

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** derivation-rule · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `grounding`
**Created:** 2026-06-10

**Artifact:** `plan:cb-schema-v2`

## Invariants

- For all active prescriptions d: deps(d) non-empty OR scheme(d.artifact) in {plan, user, session, document}
- Stipulation schemes are a closed set: plan | user | session | document
- External-source schemes (source, https, gmail) never ground a prescription
